cards.name: Global Flourishing Scholarship (2027)
cards.summary: Bu magistratura stipendiyasi Sussex universitetida 2027-yil sentabr yoki 2028-yil yanvar oyida o'qishni boshlaydigan talabalar uchun mo'ljallangan bo'lib, o'qish to'lovlariga chegirma beradi.
benefits:
O'qish to'lovlarining birinchi yiliga 
5,000 funt sterling chegirma
cards.eligibility: Bangladesh, Misr, Indoneziya, Qozog'iston, Keniya, Malayziya, Nepal, Nigeriya, Pokiston, Shri-Lanka, Tailand, Turkiya, O'zbekiston yoki Vetnam fuqarolari bo'lishi va o'qish to'lovlari uchun 'Overseas' deb tasniflangan bo'lishi kerak.
cards.eligibility_evidence: Be a national of Bangladesh, Egypt, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Malaysia, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Türkiye, Uzbekistan or Vietnam
